provenance.avoided: FLUX.1-dev is licensed for research/non-commercial use only, so it is not used for anything shipped with this map
provenance.derivation: albedo from the model; height/normal from a periodic procedural field; specular and glow derived from the albedo; sky cube faces reprojected from the panorama and detail-passed
provenance.generator: Stable Diffusion XL base 1.0 (CreativeML Open RAIL++-M) and xinsir controlnet-tile-sdxl-1.0 (same licence), both loaded from ~/dk_models; madebyollin sdxl-vae-fp16-fix (MIT) for decoding
